Takes the projection matrix of [SetCameraProjectionMatrix](SetCameraProjectionMatrix) away again. The camera then projects with [CameraZoom](CameraZoom), [CameraRange](CameraRange) and [CameraProjMode](CameraProjMode). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.
@param camera  Camera handle.
